title: Produce Traceability Request Form
subtitle: Produce Traceability: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Produce Traceability Request Form covers produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event. The traceability coordinator records Produce Traceability need, timing, access, and assignment. Produce Traceability Request Form keeps Produce Traceability exceptions visible until the traceability coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Produce Traceability Request Form at field, harvest, packing, storage, shipment, and receiving point. Document produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event identity before Produce Traceability begins. Compare produce lot, growing or packing source, transformation, shipment, recipient, and trace event findings with stated Produce Traceability criteria; route unresolved Produce Traceability issues to qualified produce-record reviewer. For Produce Traceability Request Form, confirm requirements for Produce Traceability. Ask qualified produce-record reviewer to review Produce Traceability conditions beyond the traceability coordinator's role.
